## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the [contribution guide](https://github.com/slavakurilyak/awesome-ai-agents/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and ran `go run ./cmd/validate-data` when changing project data.
- [ ] Every third-party project added has a direct public repository on GitHub, GitLab.com, or Codeberg; no particular license is required.
- [ ] I used the optional [Awesome AI Agents Curation skill](https://github.com/slavakurilyak/awesome-ai-agents/tree/main/skills/awesome-ai-agents-curation) to prepare or review this contribution.
- [ ] If this PR changes files under `skills/`, those changes are intentional and described below.

Using the skill is encouraged but not required. Contributions that follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` are welcome either way.

## Summary

Describe the change and link any related issue.

## Evidence

For project submissions, link the project's direct public repository on GitHub, GitLab.com, or Codeberg, plus evidence supporting the entry and how readers can try or inspect it. Maintainers verify forge metadata before acceptance.

## Skill changes (if applicable)

If this PR intentionally changes the public skill, explain why and summarize the change. Leave this section blank otherwise.
